extensionDescription: Fork of Tab Position Options - Select the tab opening position, new tab behavior and behavior after closing a tab
newTabDescription: Choose where new tabs are opened when you create them
matchingUrlsDescription: Match the new tab's URL. The first matching rule wins. Patterns support regular expressions.
matchingUrlsHelp: Default keeps the browser's position. Tab on Activate can override the position when the tab becomes active.
loadingPageDescription: Move tabs when navigating to a matching URL. The first matching rule wins. Patterns support regular expressions.
loadingPageHelp: The destination URL takes priority; server redirects can also match the original URL. Loading rules override initial tab placement. Switching tabs later applies Tab on Activate. Pinned tabs and restored pages keep their positions.
popupDescription: Open pop-up windows as tabs in the last focused normal window.
popupAsNewTab: Open pop-up window as new tab
popupExceptionsHelp: Matching URLs keep their pop-up window. Patterns support regular expressions.
popupHelp: Converted tabs start at the end. Loading Page rules apply on navigation, and later tab switching follows Tab on Activate. Restored pop-up windows stay unchanged.
closingDescription: Choose which tab becomes active when you close the current tab
activationDescription: Move a tab to the first or last position when it becomes active. Pinned tabs stay in place.
invalidPattern: Enter a valid URL pattern for each rule.
saveFailed: Failed to save settings. Please try again.
imported: Settings loaded into the form. Click Save Settings to apply them.
importFailed: Could not import this file. Choose a valid settings file exported by Tab Position Options Fork.
exportFailed: Could not export settings. Check the URL patterns and try again.
settingsTransferHelp: Export the settings currently shown, including unsaved changes. Import replaces the settings in this form; click Save Settings to apply them. Files are processed locally.
toggleLastActive: Switch to the last active tab
shortcutSortingHelp: Sorting keeps pinned tabs and group boundaries in place. Tabs are sorted within each group and each continuous ungrouped section.
externalDescription: External links have a different protocol, host, or port. Applies to ordinary left-clicks on HTTP(S) links, including links in frames.
externalEnabled: Open external links in new tabs
externalRulesHelp: Patterns support regular expressions. Priority: page exclusions, link URL rules, page URL rules, then external links. The first match in each category wins.
externalPlacementHelp: Explicit foreground/background rules take priority over New Tab activation settings. New Tab positioning, Tab on Activate, and Loading Page rules still apply.
settingsSyncHelp: Settings and URL rules sync automatically when Chrome sync is enabled. If sync is unavailable or its storage limit is exceeded, settings stay on this device.
settingsSyncCapacity: Settings exceed the sync storage limit and are kept on this device. Reduce the number or length of URL rules and save again to retry.
settingsSyncUnavailable: Settings could not be synchronized. Saved settings remain on this device. Synchronization will retry on the next settings change or extension startup.
settingsSyncStatusUnavailable: The sync status could not be read. Reopen the settings page to check again.
shortcutsSaveHelp: Shortcut changes are applied in Chrome and do not require Save Settings here.
